documentation: Tuning constants and sources. Seasons, teams, fixtures, scores and home advantage are read from the data on every run. Settings were chosen on the previous season, each day or week predicted only from earlier games. Bookmaker moneylines: NFL from nflverse; NBA and NHL from ESPN's scoreboard (DraftKings), saved before each game starts in data/market.json.

rule.name: A
rule.text: Bet our favourite when it is the away team and the bookmaker's chance for it (margin taken out) is at least 1 point higher than ours.
rule.found: Checked on closing moneylines with the EPA model, each week predicted only from earlier weeks: this season to week 11, 27 bets, 24 won, +24%; last season 43 bets, +9.8%. Low prices (about 1.40), so one loss costs a lot. On the page for testing only.

rule.name: F
rule.text: Bet our favourite when the bookmaker's chance for it (margin taken out) is 5 to 10 points higher than ours. When the market rates our favourite even higher than we do, it usually wins more often than either of us says; much further apart, something like a missing star is usually behind it.
rule.found: Found on closing DraftKings prices: last season 246 bets, +7.0%; this season to 16 November 40 bets, +5.1% (286 bets, 81% won, average odds 1.33, +19.2 units). Many rules were tried to find it, so treat it as a test.
